Job Description: Director of PMO – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Director of Project Management Office (PMO) is responsible for establishing, leading, and managing the organization's Project Management Office to ensure effective governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of strategic and operational projects.

The role oversees the project portfolio across insurance, investment, corporate operations, technology, digital transformation, and business development functions. The Director of PMO ensures projects are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, quality standards, and organizational objectives while maintaining effective risk management, resource allocation, and stakeholder engagement.

The successful candidate will drive project management excellence, strengthen governance frameworks, improve delivery performance, and ensure that project outcomes contribute to business growth, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and customer experience.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. PMO Strategy, Leadership & Governance

  • Establish, develop, and lead the organization's Project Management Office.
  • Define PMO strategy, policies, methodologies, standards, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement standardized project management processes, tools, templates, and reporting structures.
  • Establish project approval processes, stage gates, escalation procedures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Promote project management best practices across departments and business units.
  • Ensure alignment between project execution and corporate strategy.

B. Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the organization's project portfolio, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Evaluate project proposals, business cases, feasibility studies, and investment requirements.
  • Prioritize projects based on business value, financial impact, risk, and resource availability.
  • Monitor project dependencies, interdepartmental coordination, and portfolio-level risks.
  • Provide recommendations to senior management regarding project prioritization and resource allocation.
  • Track portfolio performance and ensure delivery of expected business benefits.

C. Project Planning & Execution

  • Oversee the planning, scheduling, budgeting, and execution of strategic projects.
  • Ensure project managers develop comprehensive project plans, milestones, deliverables, and resource requirements.
  • Monitor project progress and identify delays, delivery challenges, and performance gaps.
  • Drive corrective actions and escalation processes to maintain project delivery commitments.
  • Ensure projects are completed within approved scope, budget, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure smooth project implementation.

D. Insurance & Investment Project Oversight

  • Oversee projects related to insurance operations, underwriting, claims management, policy administration, and distribution.
  • Coordinate initiatives involving investment operations, financial products, portfolio reporting, and client services, where applicable.
  • Support the implementation of regulatory, compliance, risk management, and internal control initiatives.
  • Monitor projects involving new product development, market expansion, operational improvements, and business integration.
  • Ensure project deliverables reflect the operational and regulatory requirements of the insurance and financial services industry.

E. Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Oversee technology-enabled transformation projects, including core insurance systems, CRM, ERP, digital platforms, and automation initiatives.
  • Coordinate with IT, technology, operations, and business teams to ensure successful implementation.
  • Monitor technology project budgets, vendor performance, implementation timelines, and delivery quality.
  • Support digitalization, process automation, data management, and operational efficiency initiatives.
  • Ensure technology projects deliver measurable business outcomes.

F. Financial & Resource Management

  • Develop and monitor project budgets, financial forecasts, and expenditure reports.
  • Ensure effective allocation and utilization of project resources.
  • Monitor project costs, financial variances, and budget performance.
  • Evaluate project financial risks and recommend cost-control measures.
  • Coordinate with Finance and Procurement teams on project funding, contracts, and vendor payments.
  • Assess project return on investment (ROI) and benefits realization.

G. Risk Management, Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Establish project risk management frameworks and escalation mechanisms.
  • Identify, assess, and monitor project risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery constraints.
  • Ensure projects comply with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and governance standards.
  • Monitor project quality and ensure deliverables meet agreed specifications.
  • Maintain project documentation, audit trails, and management records.
  • Coordinate with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Internal Audit teams.

H. Performance Monitoring & Executive Reporting

  • Develop project dashboards, management reports, and portfolio performance metrics.
  • Present project status, risks, budget performance, and delivery updates to executive leadership.
  • Provide timely visibility into project delays, resource constraints, and critical dependencies.
  • Monitor project KPIs and ensure accountability among project managers.
  • Lead project review meetings and portfolio governance sessions.
  • Recommend improvements to project delivery processes and organizational performance.

I. Stakeholder & Team Management

  • Lead and develop project managers, PMO analysts, and project support professionals.
  • Build strong working relationships with senior executives, department heads, project sponsors, and external vendors.
  • Facilitate communication and coordination across business units and functional teams.
  • Develop project management capabilities through training, coaching, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Finance, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Project Management, Finance, or a relevant discipline is preferred.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum 10–15 years of progressive professional experience in project management, program management, or portfolio management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior PMO leadership or Director-level position.
  • Proven experience establishing, managing, or transforming a Project Management Office.
  • Experience overseeing complex, enterprise-wide projects and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Background in insurance, banking, financial services, investment management, or related industries is highly desirable.
  • Experience managing large project portfolios, budgets, resources, and multiple project teams.
  • Exposure to digital transformation, technology implementation, business process improvement, and organizational change initiatives.

Preferred Certifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Managing Successful Programmes (MSP).

  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

- Lean Six Sigma certification.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic project and portfolio management.
  • PMO governance and operational leadership.
  • Financial planning and budget management.

- Risk assessment and problem-solving.

  • Executive communication and stakeholder management.
  • Change management and business transformation.
  • Leadership, team development, and decision-making.
  • Project management systems and reporting tools.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of projects delivered on time and within approved budgets.
  • Overall project portfolio performance and delivery success rate.

- Project cost and schedule variance.

  • Achievement of project milestones and strategic objectives.

- Project benefits realization and ROI.

  • Effectiveness of project governance and reporting.
  • Project risk identification, mitigation, and resolution.
  • Resource utilization and allocation efficiency.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and project sponsor feedback.
  • PMO process maturity and continuous improvement.
  • Compliance with project management standards and regulatory requirements.

Amid clinical workforce shortages, rising healthcare costs, and ongoing concerns about inequity, IMPaCT unlocks the power of the grassroots community health workforce.

Here at IMPaCT Care, we get out of bed every day to change lives, with the most effective intervention in the world for addressing health inequity. We find, train and enable Community Health Workers to make magic: caring people who keep their communities healthy. We have built the largest and most scientifically proven Community Health Worker platform in the country, used across 22 states by 70+ organizations like Kaiser Permanente, CVS and United Way. Across multiple randomized controlled trials, IMPaCT has achieved outcomes frequently believed to be out of reach, including $2,500 in annual savings per patient, improved mental health and a Net Promoter Score of 94. There is even a new Medicare billing code for Community Health Workers that is modeled after IMPaCT!

We are changing the game, but also know the importance of enjoying the journey. We provide competitive compensation and equity grants, comprehensive benefits and plenty of opportunities for team building and fun. Plus you get to work from home.

Curious? Read on.

Who You Are

You are the person who keeps the plan. When 6 people are talking at once on a customer call about data files, go-live dates and who owns what, you are already typing the action items, assigning owners and setting due dates. By the time the call ends, your recap is ready to send.

  • An air traffic controller: you run a 200-task Asana plan across several customers and always know what is landing next.
  • A live capture pro: you think while you type, and you organize as you go. Notes land in the right place the first time.
  • One step ahead: like a great surgical tech who hands over the next instrument before anyone asks, you anticipate what the team and the customer will need next.
  • Unafraid of complexity: Medicare, Medicaid, SFTP, eligibility files. When you hear a term you do not know, you ask, learn it and use it correctly the next time.
  • Warm and professional: you welcome customers to a call, deliver hard news with calm and kindness, and guide people through change.
  • Here to master the craft: you love this kind of work and want to grow in it.

What You Will Do

Run the plan

  • Build project plans that work backward from customer goals, tracking every deliverable, owner and deadline.
  • Capture decisions and next steps in real time in Asana and Salesforce (for example, "Per 6/15 discussion, Sunbelt will pilot new workflows by Q3").
  • Act as the hub between internal teams (Product, Tech, Workforce Development, Clinical) and hold everyone to the timeline.

See around corners

  • Spot risks early and flag them before they become blockers.
  • Know what to solve on your own and when to escalate.
  • Prepare customers for delays and tradeoffs before they become surprises.

Deliver for customers

  • Partner with a Director of Clinical Strategy to support 4-12 healthcare customers, depending on complexity.
  • Coordinate end-to-end Community Health Worker program launches and platform adoption.
  • Prepare agendas, decks and quarterly business reviews, and pull customer reports.
  • Own the Tech Review process with customer IT and compliance teams.
  • Triage a steady flow of email, Slack and customer requests so nothing is missed.

What You Bring

  • Required: a Bachelor's degree and a project management certification (PMP or CAPM).
  • 2+ years managing complex projects, implementations, or operations with external customers or partners.
  • A track record of managing concurrent projects with zero dropped balls.
  • The ability to turn a long discussion into a 1-page summary executives love.
  • Hands-on skill with Asana or a similar tool, the Google suite, Zoom and a CRM such as Salesforce.
  • Ability to work primarily during Eastern Time business hours.
  • Occasional travel for team retreats and customer site visits.

Nice to have: familiarity with U.S. healthcare (health systems, payers, community-based organizations) or experience at a health tech or SaaS startup.

Our Hiring Process

Live note-taking is central to this role, so we test it early. After you apply and answer a few short questions, selected candidates complete a short live note-taking exercise and a screening interview, followed by a project plan exercise and team interviews.

IMPaCT Care is committed to providing an inclusive interview experience. If you need any accommodations to participate fully, please let us know.

One of our core values is to create a diverse workplace that welcomes and values each team member's unique perspective, background and ideas. We are committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace.

Salary: $75,000 – $95,000 / year

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

The successful candidate will be is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining automation solutions to support enterprise infrastructure and IT operations. This role leverages Ansible and related automation technologies to streamline system configuration, software deployments, patch management, provisioning, and routine operational processes across diverse technology environments.   • Build and optimize Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions with CI/CD pipelines, version control best practices, and automated testing frameworks to ensure code quality and reliability
  • Collaborate within Agile and Scaled Agile frameworks with cross-functional teams including infrastructure, security, and service teams to deliver integrated solutions

  • Document solutions, create runbooks, and maintain knowledge base articles
  • Provide technical support for automations, troubleshoot production issues, and participate in on-call rotation as needed
  • Stay current with emerging automation technologies and contribute to automation standards, best practices, and governance frameworks
  • Other duties assigned as necessary

Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship required with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance.
  • Must be willing to undergo a pre-employment credit check as required by the Customer.
  • Bachelors Degree and 8 years of experience; an Associates Degree and 10 years of experience, a Masters Degree and 6 years of experience, or a High School Diploma or equivalent and 12 years of experience
  • Extensive experience in end-to-end enterprise software development life cycle experience, automation including maintenance and support
  • Advanced Ansible Expertise with proven experience developing playbooks, roles, modules and workflows for complex and secure enterprise environments
  • Advanced skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for custom automation solutions
  • Expertise in building RESTful APIs using modern frameworks (FastAPI, Flask) and implementing diverse integration patterns to trigger and orchestrate automation workflows
  • Proficiency in version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks
  • Strong understanding of Linux/Unix systems, Windows, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure)
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or equivalent background or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with automation orchestration platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, ARIA ) is a plus
  • Working experience in Agile and Scaled Agile environments
  • Knowledge of secure coding standards and banking environment is a plus

About the Role

Dozuki delivers immediate, high-value operational impact from day one. In this role, you build on that initial success to establish Dozuki as the enterprise-wide standard for how frontline work is documented, trained, and executed across entire manufacturing organizations.

You will own a portfolio of existing enterprise manufacturing accounts. You will grow them by finding new plants, departments, and use cases, and by turning single-site deployments into multi-facility agreements. These are complex, consultative sales. You will work across operations, quality, EHS, IT, and procurement, so you need both enterprise selling skill and a working understanding of how plants actually run.

Our Story
Imagine being part of a team that’s not just shaping the future but actively driving it. At Davies North America, we’re at the forefront of innovation and excellence, blending cutting-edge technology with top-tier professional services. As a vital part of the global Davies Group, we help businesses navigate risk, optimize operations, and spearhead transformation in the insurance and regulated sectors.

The Claim Counsel / Senior Complex Representative manages high-severity and technically complex claims across healthcare and specialty professional liability programs. The portfolio may include Medical Malpractice and Healthcare Professional Liability, Miscellaneous Errors & Omissions, broker and insurance professionals E&O, claims involving third-party administrators and other insurance service providers, insurers’ extra-contractual liability exposures, and Directors & Officers Liability.
The role serves as a subject matter resource to carriers and internal teams, providing independent evaluations of coverage, liability, damages, litigation posture, reserve adequacy, and resolution strategy. Depending on program needs, the position may also handle general liability components of healthcare package policies and other related specialty exposures.
This position is well-suited for an attorney with insurance coverage and complex claims experience or a senior claims professional with substantial experience in healthcare liability, professional liability, management liability, or other specialty lines.

Key Responsibilities

Coverage Analysis

  • Evaluate coverage issues specific to healthcare professional liability, miscellaneous and insurance professionals E&O, insurers’ extra-contractual liability, and D&O claims.
  • Analyze claims-made and occurrence triggers, retroactive dates, prior knowledge and prior acts issues, interrelated claims, notice and reporting requirements, multiple insureds, allocation between coverages, and other complex coverage questions.
  • Draft and issue coverage position letters, including reservations of rights and denial letters, ensuring clarity and compliance with legal and regulatory standards.
  • Evaluate and provide input on coverage forms and policy language as needed by carriers.
  • Review and interpret primary, excess, and package policies, endorsements, applications, and applicable law to determine coverage, exclusions, conditions, limits, retentions, allocation, and other obligations.

Claims Investigation & Strategy

  • Direct and conduct timely, thorough investigations, including review of pleadings, contracts, medical records, claim files, facility records, professional services documentation, correspondence, regulatory materials, and other relevant evidence.
  • For healthcare claims, coordinate with medical experts, nurses, facility personnel, administrators, and defense counsel to assess standards of care, causation, clinical issues, and damages
  • For E&O and management liability claims, analyze the scope of professional services or management duties, alleged errors or omissions, economic loss, reliance, causation, contractual obligations, regulatory considerations, and available defenses.
  • For extra-contractual claims, evaluate underlying claim-handling facts, settlement opportunities, communications, damages, and applicable legal standards without prejudging coverage or liability.
  • Develop, document, and execute claim strategies, action plans, and litigation management plans tailored to the applicable program and carrier requirements.
  • Provide carriers with objective, concise, and timely reports addressing material facts, coverage, liability, damages, reserves, litigation developments, and recommended next steps.

Negotiation & Settlement

  • Select or work with approved defense counsel and experts, establish expectations, monitor performance, and ensure compliance with litigation and billing guidelines.
  • Assess pleadings, dispositive motion opportunities, discovery strategy, expert needs, trial posture, and resolution options.
  • Evaluate exposure and establish or recommend reserves in accordance with carrier guidelines and delegated authority.
  • Develop settlement strategies and negotiate settlements within assigned authority, balancing legal risk, financial exposure, policy considerations, and business objectives.

Job Description: Director of PMO – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Director of Project Management Office (PMO) is responsible for establishing, leading, and managing the organization's Project Management Office to ensure effective governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of strategic and operational projects.

The role oversees the project portfolio across insurance, investment, corporate operations, technology, digital transformation, and business development functions. The Director of PMO ensures projects are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, quality standards, and organizational objectives while maintaining effective risk management, resource allocation, and stakeholder engagement.

The successful candidate will drive project management excellence, strengthen governance frameworks, improve delivery performance, and ensure that project outcomes contribute to business growth, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and customer experience.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. PMO Strategy, Leadership & Governance

  • Establish, develop, and lead the organization's Project Management Office.
  • Define PMO strategy, policies, methodologies, standards, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement standardized project management processes, tools, templates, and reporting structures.
  • Establish project approval processes, stage gates, escalation procedures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Promote project management best practices across departments and business units.
  • Ensure alignment between project execution and corporate strategy.

B. Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the organization's project portfolio, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Evaluate project proposals, business cases, feasibility studies, and investment requirements.
  • Prioritize projects based on business value, financial impact, risk, and resource availability.
  • Monitor project dependencies, interdepartmental coordination, and portfolio-level risks.
  • Provide recommendations to senior management regarding project prioritization and resource allocation.
  • Track portfolio performance and ensure delivery of expected business benefits.

C. Project Planning & Execution

  • Oversee the planning, scheduling, budgeting, and execution of strategic projects.
  • Ensure project managers develop comprehensive project plans, milestones, deliverables, and resource requirements.
  • Monitor project progress and identify delays, delivery challenges, and performance gaps.
  • Drive corrective actions and escalation processes to maintain project delivery commitments.
  • Ensure projects are completed within approved scope, budget, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure smooth project implementation.

D. Insurance & Investment Project Oversight

  • Oversee projects related to insurance operations, underwriting, claims management, policy administration, and distribution.
  • Coordinate initiatives involving investment operations, financial products, portfolio reporting, and client services, where applicable.
  • Support the implementation of regulatory, compliance, risk management, and internal control initiatives.
  • Monitor projects involving new product development, market expansion, operational improvements, and business integration.
  • Ensure project deliverables reflect the operational and regulatory requirements of the insurance and financial services industry.

E. Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Oversee technology-enabled transformation projects, including core insurance systems, CRM, ERP, digital platforms, and automation initiatives.
  • Coordinate with IT, technology, operations, and business teams to ensure successful implementation.
  • Monitor technology project budgets, vendor performance, implementation timelines, and delivery quality.
  • Support digitalization, process automation, data management, and operational efficiency initiatives.
  • Ensure technology projects deliver measurable business outcomes.

F. Financial & Resource Management

  • Develop and monitor project budgets, financial forecasts, and expenditure reports.
  • Ensure effective allocation and utilization of project resources.
  • Monitor project costs, financial variances, and budget performance.
  • Evaluate project financial risks and recommend cost-control measures.
  • Coordinate with Finance and Procurement teams on project funding, contracts, and vendor payments.
  • Assess project return on investment (ROI) and benefits realization.

G. Risk Management, Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Establish project risk management frameworks and escalation mechanisms.
  • Identify, assess, and monitor project risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery constraints.
  • Ensure projects comply with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and governance standards.
  • Monitor project quality and ensure deliverables meet agreed specifications.
  • Maintain project documentation, audit trails, and management records.
  • Coordinate with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Internal Audit teams.

H. Performance Monitoring & Executive Reporting

  • Develop project dashboards, management reports, and portfolio performance metrics.
  • Present project status, risks, budget performance, and delivery updates to executive leadership.
  • Provide timely visibility into project delays, resource constraints, and critical dependencies.
  • Monitor project KPIs and ensure accountability among project managers.
  • Lead project review meetings and portfolio governance sessions.
  • Recommend improvements to project delivery processes and organizational performance.

I. Stakeholder & Team Management

  • Lead and develop project managers, PMO analysts, and project support professionals.
  • Build strong working relationships with senior executives, department heads, project sponsors, and external vendors.
  • Facilitate communication and coordination across business units and functional teams.
  • Develop project management capabilities through training, coaching, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Finance, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Project Management, Finance, or a relevant discipline is preferred.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum 10–15 years of progressive professional experience in project management, program management, or portfolio management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior PMO leadership or Director-level position.
  • Proven experience establishing, managing, or transforming a Project Management Office.
  • Experience overseeing complex, enterprise-wide projects and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Background in insurance, banking, financial services, investment management, or related industries is highly desirable.
  • Experience managing large project portfolios, budgets, resources, and multiple project teams.
  • Exposure to digital transformation, technology implementation, business process improvement, and organizational change initiatives.

Preferred Certifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Managing Successful Programmes (MSP).

  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

- Lean Six Sigma certification.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic project and portfolio management.
  • PMO governance and operational leadership.
  • Financial planning and budget management.

- Risk assessment and problem-solving.

  • Executive communication and stakeholder management.
  • Change management and business transformation.
  • Leadership, team development, and decision-making.
  • Project management systems and reporting tools.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of projects delivered on time and within approved budgets.
  • Overall project portfolio performance and delivery success rate.

- Project cost and schedule variance.

  • Achievement of project milestones and strategic objectives.

- Project benefits realization and ROI.

  • Effectiveness of project governance and reporting.
  • Project risk identification, mitigation, and resolution.
  • Resource utilization and allocation efficiency.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and project sponsor feedback.
  • PMO process maturity and continuous improvement.
  • Compliance with project management standards and regulatory requirements.

WHO WE ARE: MagicSchool is the premier generative AI platform for teachers. We're just over 2 years old, and more than 7 million teachers from all over the world have joined our platform. Join a top team at a fast growing company that is working towards real social impact. Make an account and try us out at our website and connect with our passionate community on our Wall of Love.

As Director of Information Technology (IT) & Security, you will lead and scale our IT and information security functions, ensuring the systems and practices that power our work are reliable, secure, and scalable. You'll inherit a solid foundation (centralized identity and access management, automated account provisioning, and an active SOC 2 program) and be accountable for maturing it as we grow. In this hands-on, individual contributor role, you'll manage everything from infrastructure to incident response while advising on strategic technology decisions.

You'll report directly to the Sr. Director of Operations and play a critical role in shaping our operational backbone. This position is hybrid, with an expectation of working onsite one day per week. Availability onsite in Denver is required as needed for company technology support, including onsite visits, board meetings, and other related activities.

RESPONSIBILITIES

In this role, you will be responsible for driving to the following outcomes:

IT Management

  • Manage a help-desk, develop and enforce technology policies and procedures, and own end-to-end employee lifecycle IT processes, including onboarding, offboarding, and access management, in partnership with People Operations.

  • Manage procurement of hardware and software, maintain accurate inventory tracking, and ensure timely, cost-effective equipment distribution.

  • Oversee vendor management across SaaS tools and IT services, including selection, negotiations, and renewals.

  • Lead AI and technology enablement: administer our AI tools and train our team on the effective and secure use of technology.

Security Program Management

  • Manage a comprehensive security program aligned with industry standards (SOC 2, NIST, ISO 27001) and EdTech regulations (FERPA, COPPA).

  • Create and maintain incident response plans, conduct risk assessments, and drive security awareness across the organization.

  • Own our SOC 2 audit cycle, partnering with teams across the company to gather evidence and close findings.

Project Execution

  • Lead and execute complex IT and security projects, ensuring effective management and timely delivery in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Own and drive initiatives such as device management, integrations between our HR, finance, and identity systems, system migrations, access control audits, and infrastructure scaling.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, product, legal, People Operations, finance, and other teams to integrate security across all operations and communicate risks and strategies clearly to the organization.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor on technology decisions that affect the broader business.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

To be successful in this role, you'll bring the following experience and qualifications:

  • Professional Experience: At least 7 years of relevant experience in information technology and security, with proven experience executing complex projects in a startup environment.

  • Compliance Expertise: Strong knowledge of security frameworks (SOC 2, NIST, ISO 27001) and EdTech regulations (FERPA, COPPA).

  • Technical Depth: Hands-on experience with identity and device management platforms (such as JumpCloud or Okta), scripting (Python preferred), APIs, and cloud infrastructure (AWS).

  • Execution Skills: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-impact projects with a high level of ownership and attention to detail.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent ability to simplify complex security topics and communicate effectively across all levels of the organization.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI technology that directly impacts educators and students.

  • Join a mission-driven team passionate about making education more efficient and equitable.

  • Flexibility of working from home, while fostering a unique culture built on relationships, trust, communication, and collaboration with our team - no matter where they live.

For full time employees:

  • Unlimited time off to empower our employees to manage their work-life balance. We work hard for our teachers and users, and encourage our employees to rest and take the time they need.

  • Choice of employer-paid health insurance plans so that you can take care of yourself and your family. Dental and vision are also offered at very low premiums.

  • Every employee is offered generous stock options, vested over 4 years.

  • 401k match & monthly wellness stipend.

Our Values:

  • Educators are Magic: Educators are the most important ingredient in the educational process - they are the magic, not the AI. Trust them, empower them, and put them at the center of leading change in service of students and families.

  • Joy and Magic: Bring joy and magic into every learning experience - push the boundaries of what’s possible with AI.

  • Community: Foster community that supports one another during a time of rapid technological change. Listen to them and serve their needs.

  • Innovation: The education system is outdated and in need of innovation and change - AI is an opportunity to bring equity, access, and serve the individual needs of students better than we ever have before.

  • Responsibility: Put responsibility and safety at the forefront of the technological change that AI is bringing to education.

  • Diversity: Diversity of thought, perspectives, and backgrounds helps us serve the wide audience of educators and students around the world.

  • Excellence: Educators and students deserve the best - and we strive for the highest quality in everything we do.

Compensation Range: $200K - $280K

Imagine yourself…

  • Owning your ambition and fueling your career growth.
  • Collaborating with a vibrant, inclusive, global team.
  • Joining a company with a proven track record of success and an exciting future.
  • Contributing to a brighter, more sustainable future.

It’s all possible with a role at Esko. Esko, a Veralto company, is a global provider of integrated software and hardware solutions that accelerate the go-to-market process of packaged goods. Our integrated platform and comprehensive tools empower retailers, pre-media and trade shops, manufacturers, and converters to manage best-in-class packaging design and print processes.


Innovation is built into the DNA of our business: every day, we challenge ourselves to be better by seeking out new ways to elevate our products, our processes, and our people.


We also know that innovation and ingenuity starts with prioritizing a diverse workforce and a deeply inclusive workplace. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions. 


We’re seeking a Commercial Counsel to support Esko’s global commercial legal operations, with a focus on SaaS and software licensing transactions. You will negotiate commercial agreements, coordinate regulatory matters affecting our products, and help build the frameworks, tools and team that make our legal function faster and more scalable. This role is also an opportunity to help shape a new legal Center of Excellence (CoE) in Europe. You will contribute to its set-up and, over time, may take on a leadership role as it grows. You will work closely with sales, service, procurement, R&D and the broader Veralto legal team across Europe and the United States, with meaningful autonomy and direct access to senior business stakeholders.


This is a remote role based in Czechia or Poland, with occasional domestic and international travel of up to 20%.


In this role, you will be:

  • Negotiating, drafting and approving commercial agreements, including SaaS agreements, software licensing, partnership and procurement contracts, NDAs and Data Protection Agreements.
  • Supporting commercial legal work for other Veralto operating companies, including GlobalVision, TraceGains and X-Rite Pantone, as business needs require.
  • Providing clear, practical legal guidance to business leaders and sales and service teams, translating complex legal matters into actionable advice.
  • Partnering with sales and commercial teams to accelerate customer-facing deal execution across diverse geographies and legal frameworks.
  • Supporting M&A activity, including due diligence, documentation and integration planning, in collaboration with the Lead Commercial Counsel and cross-functional partners.
  • Coordinating regulatory work affecting products and operations, including data management, cybersecurity, privacy, AI and product liability.
  • Working with R&D, product, IT security and compliance teams to anticipate regulatory developments and translate them into practical requirements and contract positions.
  • Designing and delivering training on AI best practices and regulation, distributor management, competition law, compliance and privacy.
  • Acting as a PMO for legal workstreams by creating and maintaining guidelines, templates, playbooks and RACI frameworks.
  • Identifying opportunities to use legal technology and AI tools to improve efficiency and helping to roll them out responsibly.
  • Championing proactive risk management by identifying emerging legal issues and developing scalable, pragmatic solutions.
  • Helping to design and build the potential future legal CoE, including its scope, processes, tooling and ways of working with the wider legal team.
  • Contributing to potentially recruiting, onboarding and developing future team members and, as the CoE grows, taking on management responsibility where appropriate.

The essential requirements of the job

  • Law degree with 6-8 years' experience in an international law firm, a multinational company, or both.
  • Significant experience with software-related commercial matters, including SaaS agreements, software licensing and hosted services, from a sell-side perspective.
  • Fluency in English with exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex legal concepts to non-legal audiences.
  • A proven track record of managing complex, multi-party commercial negotiations independently and with sound judgement.
  • Strong collaboration and listening skills, with the ability to prioritise effectively, work autonomously in a remote international team and remain flexible in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong capability in regulatory horizon scanning and related training.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required, up to 20%.

Preferred experience also includes:

  • In-house counsel experience in a technology or software company and/or experience with international law firms.
  • Experience negotiating with both large multinational companies and smaller businesses.
  • Experience building templates, playbooks or legal operations processes, or working with legal AI tools.
  • Experience in M&A due diligence and processes.
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks for technology, AI and data, such as NIS2, the Data Act, the EU AI Act and product liability rules.
  • Experience coaching or managing junior lawyers, or setting up a shared-service or CoE model.
  • Admission to a bar in an EU member state.

Esko is proud to part of the Product Quality & Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto’s vibrant global network of 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you’ll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we’re Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™—and building rewarding careers along the way.

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve.Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

      <title>Current: Freelance Marketo Email Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Front-End Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote (US)
</p>

<h3>&nbsp;</h3>
<h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2>
<p>As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands. This is a hands-on, execution-only contract role with no leadership or management responsibilities. You'll take approved briefs and turn them into working programs, building responsive templates and modules, setting up smart lists and flows, and making sure every send goes out right the first time. You know Marketo well enough to spot a broken token, a misfired trigger, or a segmentation gap before it reaches a subscriber. You'll take direction from our internal team, get up to speed fast, and deliver accurate builds on schedule with minimal oversight.</p>
<h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Build and launch email programs in Marketo, including one-off sends, nurture streams, engagement programs, and triggered campaigns.</li>
<li>Develop and maintain responsive email templates and modular components in HTML and CSS, using Marketo's template syntax, variables, and editable sections.</li>
<li>Set up smart lists, smart campaigns, flow steps, and segmentations that match the targeting and logic in the brief.</li>
<li>Use tokens, dynamic content, and snippets to personalize emails and keep programs easy to clone and reuse.</li>
<li>QA every email before launch: rendering across clients and devices (e.g. Litmus or Email on Acid), links, tokens, personalization fallbacks, and list logic.</li>
<li>Manage program structure, naming conventions, and folder organization so client instances stay clean and easy to navigate.</li>
<li>Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.</li>
<li>Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.</li>
<li>Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.</li>
<li>Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Qualifications</strong></h2>
<h3><strong>Required</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying email campaigns in Marketo Engage.</li>
<li>Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.</li>
<li>Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.</li>
<li>Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.</li>
<li>A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.</li>
<li>Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.</li>
<li>Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.</li>
<li>Ability to work independently, take direction well, and hit deadlines across overlapping requests.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Preferred</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Marketo Certified Expert or Marketo Certified Associate.</li>
<li>Familiarity with email deliverability, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and list hygiene.</li>
<li>Experience with email accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG).</li>
<li>Experience with lead scoring, lifecycle programs, and Marketo–Salesforce CRM sync.</li>
<li>Experience with other marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze).</li>
<li>Agency or consulting experience.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Why Current</strong></h2>
<p>At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.</p>
<p>We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.</p>
<p>You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, and contribute to meaningful digital experiences within a growing agency environment.</p>
<p>This is a freelance, contract engagement. The target hourly rate for this role is $50 - $70 per hour. Actual rate is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/current-freelance-marketo-email-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/current-freelance-marketo-email-engineer</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Clover Health: Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - USA
</p>

<p>Clover Health is investing in our fraud detection and investigation capabilities and is seeking a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention &amp; Investigations to join our Legal department as a senior individual contributor. This hybrid role combines: (1) managing hands-on investigations of potential provider fraud with (2) building AI-powered tools and processes to make investigations more efficient and help catch potential future fraud earlier. You will develop and pilot new AI-enabled investigatory processes for Clover’s Medicare Advantage business, and own resulting investigations, in collaboration with Clover’s Special Investigations Unit (SIU) and other stakeholders.</p>
<p>This is a non-attorney role.&nbsp; You will work hand-in-hand with Clover’s lawyers and SIU to ensure that new investigatory processes you develop, and the resulting investigations, comply with Clover policies and regulatory requirements. Success in this role requires someone sharp, creative, and technically hands-on—someone who does not just use existing analytics tools but builds their own. That might mean writing a script to automate repetitive work, pulling apart a dataset when a standard report falls short, or working with an LLM until it produces something genuinely useful—all with the goal of finding smarter, more effective ways to investigate potential provider fraud.</p>
<p><strong>As a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention &amp; Investigations, you will:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Build Your Own Investigative Tooling: </strong>Use AI to write the queries, scripts, and prompts that turn millions of claim lines and/or medical record data into a prioritized list of leads. Prototype detection logic yourself rather than waiting on a roadmap, and hand off what works to data science and engineering to productionize. We expect you to be the person who builds v1.</li>
<li><strong>Investigate Potential Fraud End-to-End With AI in the Loop: </strong>Own a portfolio of fraud investigations sourced using the tooling you develop, in collaboration with Clover’s SIU. Develop investigative plans, gather and analyze evidence (including claims data and medical records), and reach well-supported conclusions.&nbsp; Use LLMs and analytics to compress the parts of an investigation that have always been slow — reading unstructured data, triaging grievance narratives, and sizing exposure.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Build Defensible Documentation: </strong>Develop case files and memos that are factually complete, well-organized, and prepared with the evidentiary and procedural standards necessary for downstream enforcement, recoveries, or provider actions.</li>
<li><strong>Collaborate Across Functions: </strong>Work with Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, provider relations, revenue operations, and SIU teams to gather information, validate findings, and translate investigative outcomes into operational improvements, provider education, and member impact.</li>
<li><strong>Communicate Findings Clearly: </strong>Prepare concise written reports and oral briefings that translate complex investigative facts into clear narratives for senior leadership and other stakeholders.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Success in this role looks like:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>In your first 90 days</strong>, you have embedded yourself as a trusted partner to both the Legal department and Clover’s SIU. You have built working relationships with key stakeholders across Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, revenue operations, and legal teams, and you have begun working through your initial portfolio of fraud investigations and ad hoc referrals.</li>
<li><strong>By 6 months</strong>, you are independently managing a steady caseload of fraud investigations with consistently high-quality work product, in collaboration with SIU. You have a clear working rhythm with Legal and SIU, and you have built at least one working tool — a script, a notebook, a dashboard, a prompt.</li>
<li><strong>By 12 months</strong>, you have a track record of strong investigations, successful recoveries and/or referrals, and effective cross-functional collaboration. Senior leaders across Clover view you as a trusted person to call when they have a hunch that something doesn't look right and want it examined.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>You should get in touch if:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Knowledge of healthcare fraud schemes &amp; investigative experience: </strong>You have experience in healthcare fraud investigations, program integrity, or SIU operations, ideally within Medicare Advantage or managed care.&nbsp; You understand healthcare fraud schemes and know how to use claims data, medical records, and provider documentation to build a defensible factual record.</li>
<li><strong>You are AI-native and enjoy building things using LLMs:</strong> You can use LLMs to write SQL, Python, etc., to interrogate large claims and/or medical record datasets, automate investigative work, and prototype your own solutions rather than waiting for someone else to build them. <em>We do not expect production-grade engineering or require formal technical training—we value demonstrated ability to build, ship, and showcase solutions that work.</em></li>
<li><strong>Strong communication skills: </strong>You are a strong writer and communicator who can turn complex investigative findings into clear memos, referrals, and executive summaries, and you are comfortable building in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Bonus points if:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<ul>
<li>You have built something people actually use—an internal tool, detection model, script, automation, or AI workflow that made a manual process better. We would rather see something scrappy and useful in production than something polished in a slide.</li>
<li>You have hands-on experience applying AI/ML to fraud, investigations, or compliance.</li>
<li>You have a J.D., legal training, or experience working alongside Legal, SIU, or compliance at a health plan.</li>
<li>You have industry certifications such as CFE, AHFI, or CHC.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<p><strong>Benefits Overview</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Financial Well-Being</strong>: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.</li>
<li><strong>Physical Well-Being</strong>: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.</li>
<li><strong>Mental Well-Being</strong>: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. <div class="content-intro"><p>Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.</p>
<p>Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.</p>
<p>We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.&nbsp;</p></div><p>We are hiring a <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> for the Product Platform team, which owns the foundational layer of our API that all other Lithic products build on top. The team’s mission is to make Lithic's API the best in fintech — reliable, consistent, and a joy to integrate with. This includes API Gateway, Events Platform, API key management and authorization, audit logging, or API norms and versioning strategy.</p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York City, Remote
</p>

<h2>Alloy is where you belong!</h2>
<p>Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.<br><br>Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of <a href="https://www.inc.com/profile/alloy_ny">Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces</a>, <a href="https://www.forbes.com/companies/alloy/?list=americas-best-startup-employers&amp;sh=55c076453c61">Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers</a>, <a href="https://www.americanbanker.com/list/best-places-to-work-in-fintech-2022">Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker</a>, year after year.<br><br>Check out our investors and read more about us <a href="https://www.alloy.com/about">here</a>.</p>
<h2>About the team</h2>
<p>We're standing up a new function at Alloy: Forward Deployed Engineering. Our largest enterprise customers need a trusted technical partner with a strong point of view on how Alloy fits into their tech stack and fraud strategy. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll be that partner - embedded with our most strategic accounts and owning the technical outcome end-to-end, with each deployment becoming the foundation for the next.</p>
<p>You'll be one of the first two engineers on this founding team. This is a software engineering role through and through - based within our Engineering org, with a scope that spans software, product, and solutions engineering. You won't just join this function - you'll define how it works.</p>
<p>Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week.</p>
<h2><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Architect and tune customer and channel-partner deployments end-to-end — API integrations, third-party data integrations, SDKs, and latency constraints.</li>
<li>Write production code across our stack: TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6/React), Python (Django), Node.js, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, and AWS.</li>
<li>Serve as Alloy's credible technical voice with customer engineering leadership, making architectural calls in real time.</li>
<li>Own the engineering track of QBRs for your accounts and serve in their on-call escalation path.</li>
<li>Turn your work into reusable platform primitives and docs, so each deployment makes the next one faster.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who we’re looking for</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of hands-on experience developing production-ready software, with a proven track record of delivering robust, scalable solutions.</li>
<li>Experience in a customer-facing technical role, Forward Deployed Engineering, solutions engineering with deep technical ownership, or similar - where you were accountable to an external stakeholder, not just an internal roadmap.</li>
<li>Strong backend and API fluency, with the ability to read and write production code across services you don't own.</li>
<li>Sound architectural judgment under ambiguity: you can make and defend technical decisions in the room, with a customer watching.</li>
<li>A genuine pull toward customer-facing work - you find energy in solving a real customer's real problem, alongside their engineers.</li>
<li>A clear technical communicator who can explain a complex integration tradeoff to a bank's VP of Engineering and to an Alloy PM in the same afternoon.</li>
<li>Ability to travel on occasion to our NYC office, as well as client offices in the US.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Nice to have:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a company with a strong Forward Deployed Engineering culture (Palantir, Scale AI, Ramp, Plaid, Stripe, etc.).</li>
<li>Familiarity with identity, fraud, KYC/KYB, or financial services infrastructure.</li>
<li>Experience with SDK development or embedded front-end integrations.</li>
</ul>
<p>We're a lean team, so your impact will be felt immediately, and opportunities will grow as the company scales up. If this all sounds like a good fit for you, why not join us?</p>
<p>Alloy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Below is the anticipated starting base compensation range for this role; however, pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, in-demand skills, relevant experience, and/or geography. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is also eligible for equity awards in the form of stock options (ISOs) as well as a competitive total benefits package. Your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details and what compensation could look like for you specifically!</p>
<p><em>This position has a salary range of $141,000 to $250,000.&nbsp;</em></p>
<h2>Benefits and Perks&nbsp;</h2>
<ul>
<li>Unlimited PTO and flexible work policy</li>
<li>Employee stock options</li>
<li>Medical, dental, vision plans with HSA (monthly employer contribution) and FSA options</li>
<li>401k with 100% match up to 4% of annual employee compensation&nbsp;</li>
<li>Eligible new parents receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave&nbsp;</li>
<li>Home office stipend for new employees</li>
<li>Annual Learning &amp; Development annual stipend</li>
<li>Well-being benefits include access to ClassPass, OneMedical, UrbanSitter, and Spring Health&nbsp;</li>
</ul>

We encourage applicants to share needed accommodations with their recruiter.</p>
<p>All Alloy jobs are listed on our careers page. Any communication during the recruitment process, including interview requests or job offers, will come directly from a recruiting team member with an <a href="http://alloy.com/">alloy.com</a> email address. We do not use outside applications or automated text messaging in our recruiting process. We will not ask for any sensitive financial or identification information during the recruiting process. If you’re ever unsure, please contact us directly via our website before sharing personal information.</p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote- USA
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><span>Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><span><strong>The Community You Will Join: </strong></span></p>
<p><span>BizTech fosters culture and connection at Airbnb by providing reliable corporate tools, innovative products, and technical support for all teams. We drive technical breakthroughs and strategies that redefine what it means to belong anywhere, delivering greater value for the business and our people. The Global Operations team at BizTech manages production services across Airbnb’s corporate environment, delivering reliable operations through Observability, Incident Management, Core Operations, and AI-enabled automation. We partner across BizTech to scale service quality, efficiency, and resilience.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>As an Operations Engineer, you'll apply AI at the forefront of BizTech's operational health: using LLM-powered triage and intelligent automation to resolve tickets, speed up incident response, and build self-healing observability that catches problems before they escalate. AI fluency is core to this role, not an add-on. You'll prototype agentic workflows, embed AI into runbooks and diagnostics, and continuously look for repetitive work automation can take over. Success looks like a shrinking backlog of recurring ticket categories through AI-assisted automation, faster MTTR powered by intelligent alerting and root-cause suggestions, and dashboards/reporting enhanced with AI-driven insights that give stakeholders clear, trustworthy visibility into service health and data quality.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>A Typical Day:&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li>Manage the ticket queue prioritizing and resolving requests while identifying recurring categories to automate or deflect</li>
<li>Participate in a rotating on-call and incident response schedule, including weekends, troubleshooting and documenting issues in real time</li>
<li>Build and maintain monitoring dashboards (Tableau, Superset, Grafana) that track service health, availability, and data quality, flagging gaps as they emerge</li>
<li>Use AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to speed up triage, root-cause analysis, scripting, and documentation — while knowing when a problem needs hands-on judgment instead</li>
<li>Write and maintain code in general-purpose languages (Python, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, Bash) to automate operational workflows</li>
<li>Partner with global stakeholder teams to drive issues to resolution</li>
</ul>
<p><br><span><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li>3+ years of experience with observability and metrics tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ElasticSearch)</li>
<li>3+ years working with data querying and pipelines (e.g., SQL, Airflow, Trino, SQS)</li>
<li>Working knowledge of network fundamentals and hardware (e.g., Cisco, Palo Alto)</li>
<li>Experience with Infrastructure as Code</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with CI/CD and automation tooling (e.g., Jenkins, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions) across AWS, GCP, or Oracle Cloud</li>
<li>Comfort working in ticket/workflow-driven environments using Jira and Confluence</li>
<li>Experience supporting enterprise SaaS tools (e.g., Salesforce, Workday) and SSO/identity integration (e.g., Okta) is a plus</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Your Location</strong></p>
<p>This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity.<a href="https://careers.airbnb.com/"> Click here</a> for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.</p>
<p><span><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</strong></span></p>

We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p>
<p><span><span>We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.&nbsp;</span></span></p>
<p><span>We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.</span></p>
<p><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity: </strong></p>
<p>Airbnb values diversity &amp; belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. <p>

</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.</p>
<p>Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.</p>
<p>We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>Position:</strong> Senior Software Engineer, Processing</p>
<p><strong>Location:</strong> Remote</p>
<p>We are hiring a <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> for our Processing team to lead Lithic’s next phase of growth.</p>
<p>The Processing team builds and maintains the real-time interfaces between Lithic and external payment networks. Every card authorization, clearing message, and settlement file flows through systems this team owns. The team manages both online and batch transaction flows across Mastercard, Visa, and Amex, along with transaction enrichment, disputes processing, and network compliance. The systems we maintain have strict latency and uptime requirements, because they sit on the critical path for every card transaction. The team also manages the physical network peering with card network partners, so infrastructure and networking expertise are important. The team primarily uses Java, Python, and Kotlin on AWS.</p>
<h3><strong>What you'll do:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Ensure high reliability, low latency, and correctness for Lithic's transaction processing interfaces and related services</li>
<li>Develop new capabilities across authorization, clearing/settlement, disputes, and network integration surfaces</li>
<li>Ensure that the team is delivering reliable, secure, and scalable code with minimal tech debt</li>
<li>Evolve the infrastructure supporting physical network peering with card network partners, ensuring connectivity, failover, and capacity meet reliability requirements</li>
<li>Own initiatives from planning to launch, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned along the way</li>
<li>Participate in the team on-call rotation</li>
<li>Lead efforts to improve systems and processes both within the team and across engineering</li>
<li>Help drive strategic planning in collaboration with the engineering manager and product manager</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>8+ years experience shipping code in fast paced production environments</li>
<li>Advanced distributed system instincts and design skills</li>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York City; Remote
</p>

<p>Squarespace is seeking a talented Staff Software Engineer to support and evolve the systems at the core core of our monetization platform: billing, payments and orders. In this role, you will provide technical oversight over the critical monetization machinery that accepts orders, processes payments and bills subscriptions. You will regularly collaborate with engineering leadership and key product, strategy and finance stakeholders to align technical strategy with Squarespace’s business objectives. This is an opportunity to take on IC technical leadership responsibilities and own system architecture for high-visibility initiatives tied directly to Squarespace's core businesses.</p>
<p>This role is open to remote or hybrid working from our NYC office 3 days per week. You will report to the Director of Revenue Systems.</p>
<h2><strong>You'll Get To...</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Own system architectural vision and design for critical areas of our business.</li>
<li>Transform high-level system vision into estimated project plans for initiatives central to Squarespace’s strategy.</li>
<li>Serve as technical lead and cross-functional liaison on business-critical projects, making and defending engineering decisions key to the success of the business.</li>
<li>Mentor engineers on the team to deliver ever greater quality with ever growing autonomy.</li>
<li>Drive best practices for engineering excellence and technical leadership, influence design reviews, question assumptions, point out pitfalls and foster shared understanding</li>
<li>Set the engineering quality bar for the team through regular, high-quality code contributions across billing, orders and payments.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who We're Looking For</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>10 or more years experience specifying, delivering and maintaining complex distributed backend services.</li>
<li>Significant experience with multiple programming languages (especially Java) and a broad range of tools like Springboot, hibernate, databases, etc.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience leading system architecture decisions across multiple teams or initiatives</li>
<li>Proven ability to serve as a technical lead on cross-functional projects, aligning engineering and business goals without sacrificing engineering quality</li>
<li>Experience working with billing, orders or payment systems at scale</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Benefits &amp; Perks</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>A choice between medical plans with an option for 100% covered premiums including medical, dental, and vision</li>
<li>Supplemental Life and Disability Insurance plans</li>
<li>Fertility and adoption benefits</li>
<li>Headspace mindfulness app subscription</li>
<li>Global Employee Assistance Program</li>
<li>Retirement benefits with employer match</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off</li>
<li>12 weeks paid parental leave and family care leave</li>
<li>Pretax commuter benefit</li>
<li>Education reimbursement</li>
<li>Employee donation match to community organizations</li>
<li>7 Global Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)</li>
<li>Dog-friendly workplace</li>
<li>Free lunch and snacks</li>
<li>Private rooftop</li>
<li>Hack week twice per year</li>
</ul>
<h3>Cash Compensation Range: $170,000 - $299,000 USD</h3>
<p>The base salary for this position will vary based on job-related criteria including relevant skills, experience, and location, among other factors.</p>
<p>In addition to the cash compensation above (which includes base salary and, where applicable for eligible roles, may include overtime pay), Squarespace employees are eligible to be granted an option to purchase our common stock. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive structure in addition to base salary.</p>
<h2><strong>About Squarespace</strong></h2>
<p>Squarespace is a design-driven platform helping entrepreneurs build brands and businesses online. We empower millions of customers in more than 200 countries and territories with all the tools they need to create an online presence, build an audience, monetize, and scale their business. Our suite of products range from websites, domains, ecommerce, and marketing tools, as well as tools for scheduling with Acuity and creating and managing social media presence with Bio Sites and Unfold. Our team of more than 1,700 is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Dublin, Ireland, and Aveiro, Portugal. For more information about our company, visit <a href="https://www.squarespace.com/about/careers">https://www.squarespace.com/about/careers</a>.</p>
<h2><strong>Our Commitment</strong></h2>
<p>Today, more than a million people around the globe use Squarespace to share different perspectives and experiences with the world. Not only do we embrace and celebrate the diversity of our customers, but we also work toward the same in our employees. At Squarespace, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.</p>
